answer: The knoll explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded tide account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the whisper binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 132 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
